services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: A new GAF roofing system, installed by a Master Elite roofer.
services.text: Replacement roofs installed with quality materials and the GAF warranty system that fits your home.
services.imageAlt: A roofer laying new shingles across a house roof
body: We believe in using the highest quality materials in the industry and have the most experienced contractors. As a Master Elite GAF contractor, Anderson Roofing and Restoration knows the best roofing system and warranty for each homeowner.

Having overseen hundreds of roofing projects in Houston and the surrounding areas, we know what system best fits your home's roof, whether that is meeting the required roofing standards for your subdivision or making sure your new roof has the proper ventilation to be as energy efficient as possible and to increase the longevity of your roof.
points: GAF System Plus, Gold Pledge and Silver Pledge lifetime warranties
Ventilation checked and upgraded with the new roof
Free estimate before any work starts
0% interest financing for up to 60 months through Wells Fargo

faqs.q: Why a GAF Master Elite contractor?
faqs.a: GAF is North America's largest roofing manufacturer. Because of GAF's stringent standards, only qualified roofing contractors who have met credit checks, background checks and valid liability insurance are able to offer GAF's lifetime warranty systems.

faqs.q: Do I definitely need a new roof?
faqs.a: Not all roofs need replacement. After a complete free roof inspection we find most roofs only need affordable repairs, and we will tell you that.

services.title: Roof Repair
services.short: Leaks, damaged shingles, vents and flashing, repaired.
services.text: Repairs to leaks and to damage from wind, hail and trees, so the water stops before it reaches your ceiling.
services.imageAlt: A plumbing vent and new shingles on a finished roof
body: Most roofs we look at need an affordable repair rather than a replacement. We find the source of the leak, show you what we found and quote the repair.
Don't wait until you see stains on your ceiling. Roof repairs also cover the damage left behind inside: interior sheetrock repair from prior leak damage, and paint to match.
points: Interior sheetrock repair from leak damage, painted to match

services.title: Roof Inspections
services.short: A complete free roof inspection, and the maintenance program.
services.text: Not all roofs need replacement. After a complete free roof inspection we help you decide what your roof actually needs.
services.imageAlt: A finished shingle roof with roof vents, seen close up
body: After a complete free roof inspection we help you decide if you need repairs, a replacement, or should file a claim with your insurance carrier for weather related damage to your roof.

We also offer roof maintenance inspections and repairs to keep you from getting those damaging leaks. Don't wait until you see stains on your ceiling: you need to have your roof inspected every three to five years. Ask about our roof maintenance program.
points: Repair, replace or file a claim, decided with you
An inspection every three to five years

services.title: Gutters
services.short: Gutters installed, with a free gutter estimate.

We make it easy to budget with a free gutter estimate, the same as we do for repairs, siding, painting and patio covers.

services.title: Attic Ventilation
services.short: Ventilation that lowers utility bills and lengthens roof life.
services.text: Let us help you update your ventilation to lower utility bills and help your roof last longer.
services.imageAlt: Ridge vent and roof vent materials on a driveway before installation

We check the ventilation when we inspect a roof, and update it with a replacement or on its own.
points: Ventilation updated to lower utility bills

services.title: Exterior and Interior Painting

Inside, we handle sheetrock repair from prior leak damage and paint to match, or paint the interior to update it or just for a color change.

Paint matched to the existing color

about.title: Locally owned and operated in Spring, Texas
text: Anderson Roofing and Restoration of Spring, Texas is a locally owned and operated business. We were created to assist homeowners with the high cost of roofing repairs and replacements.

Susan and Clint are both native Houstonians with combined 35 plus years of experience in the roofing and insurance industry, and have sold over 800 roof replacements. We will assist and walk you through filing an insurance claim from wind or hail damage, and make sure you get what you deserve from your insurance carrier.

As a Master Elite GAF contractor, we know the best roofing system and warranty for each homeowner. GAF is North America's largest roofing manufacturer, and because of GAF's stringent standards only qualified roofing contractors that have met credit checks, background checks and valid liability insurance are able to offer GAF's lifetime warranty systems.

We pride ourselves on being honest and upfront with our customers, offering a quality job done with integrity and knowledge of the roofing industry. Your roof is such an important part of your home, protecting everything inside.
